newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold demand buoyed by low prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold demand buoyed by low prices.

text.p: Traded volume on Istanbul's Gold Exchange jumped to 1,025 kilos on Wednesday due to fresh free market demand after a holiday on Tuesday and lower prices in international gold markets, traders said.
Volume was only 235 kilos in on Monday morning after which markets closed for the Republic Day holiday and reopened today. Friday's daily volume was 630 kilos.
Gold prices dived to $381.00 an ounce and 1,175,250 lira per gram against $383.60 and 1,185,200 lira at noon close on Monday.
Traders said demand was lively in the morning session as free market traders and jewellers actively bought gold after the holiday, with the help of lower world prices.
Volume was 910 kilos in the morning, but sank to 115 kilos in the second session as demand faded because afternoon deals are made with tomorrow's value.
Of the total turnover, 57 percent was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75 ATA EKS
